description: Create or open a public Superdraft workspace for a business website, requesting two email drafts and two Instagram posts with images designed as part of those drafts. Anyone with the workspace link can view and edit the saved content. Uses the shared public generation allowance and may resume failed setup. Returns promptly while generation continues. No standalone image generation, freeform image prompts, email sending, social publishing, or private account access.

website_url.description: The public business website or the canonical website_url returned by Superdraft.
